blind.B1: No exercise question: the paper (S2.1.p1-p2) studies hindlimb unloading (Contr/HS7/HS14, n=8 rats/group); exercise only appears as background (S1, S4.p1). No sample carries an exercise factor; the series is a disuse study.
blind.B2: Contr vs HS7 vs HS14 in cultured second-passage FAPs (S2.8.p1, S3.6.p1); LRT across the time course; HS7 vs Contr and HS14 vs Contr shown for PPAR genes (Fig 7). GEO: 12 libraries = 3 groups x d0/d3 x 2 reps (4 per group); paper does not say d3 samples were used for RNA-seq.
blind.B3: Cells from the 8 animals per time point were pooled before expansion (S2.2.p4), so no animal is sampled more than once; rep1/rep2 are culture replicates of a pool. No animal ID field; candidate keys in packet A (day + title suffix) are rep labels and expression check not_supported.
blind.B4: Paper: LRT over the three-group time course (one model, S2.8.p1); does not say whether differentiation day was in the model.
blind.B5: 'Differentially-expressed genes (DEGs) were determined using R package DESeq2 and filtered with p.adj < 0.01' (S2.8.p1); no fold-change cutoff; five clusters of >=30 genes each (S3.6.p1); no total DEG count.

checks.evidence: S2.1.p2: groups Contr/HS7/HS14 only; no exercise or reloading arm. Packet A flag 'Hindlimb suspension' is an exercise-word false hit; refusal correct.
Groups C/HS7/HS14 n=4 each (2 d0 + 2 d3) match GEO; paper does not give per-group RNA-seq n. d0/d3 discrepancy recorded.
S2.2.p4 pooling of 8 animals; no animal repeated; pairing_check not_supported.
Not run; paper LRT joint model noted.
Group aliased with one pooled isolation each (S2.2.p4); recorded.
Integer featureCounts matrix, max 835198, DESeq2 as in paper.
padj<0.01, no FC cutoff, transcribed correctly from S2.8.p1.

No-exercise-arm claim verified in Methods; pooling/sample_size claim supported by S2.2.p4 text (not just metadata).

summary: 该系列是后肢悬吊(失负荷)研究,没有运动臂,在设计阶段拒绝是正确的。样本为每组8只动物混池后扩增,rep1/rep2是培养重复,停止理由有论文原文支持。阈值(padj<0.01)转录无误,无阻断或重大分歧。
